name: Eliab (David's brother)
title: David's older brother
summary: Eliab was one of Jesse's sons and an older brother of King David. He is mentioned in the genealogies as the sixth son of Jesse. As a member of the tribe of Judah, he was part of the royal lineage that led to the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesse's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eliab is mentioned as the sixth of Jesse's sons in 1 Chronicles, which documents the lineage from the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's family at the anointing
keyEvents.description: When Samuel came to anoint one of Jesse's sons as king, Osem was among the brothers who passed before the prophet before David was brought forward.
